SELECT tmp.id, COALESCE(g.ordersNo, tmp.ordersNo) AS ordersNo, tmp.invoiceDate, g.allPayments, g.orderDate, tmp.invoiceObject, tmp.invoiceAmount, tmp.companyType, tmp.companyName, tmp.companyID, tmp.invoiceCompanyName, tmp.ticketPoint, tmp.ticketPointAmount, tmp.isOrderTax, tmp.Supplier, tmp.SupplierID, tmp.customer, tmp.CustomerID, tmp.comments, tmp.addtime, tmp.userId, tmp.UserName, tmp.update_time, tmp.delFlag, tmp.purchaseInvoiceAmount, tmp.ticketPointCost, tmp.ticketPointCostAmount, tmp.ticketPointIncome, tmp.ticketPointIncomeAmount, tmp.ticketPointDifference, tmp.tableName, GREATEST( COALESCE( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(g.ordersNo, tmp.ordersNo)) = 1 THEN g.allPayments - tmp.invoiceAmount ELSE g.allPayments - (SELECT SUM(tmp1.invoiceAmount) FROM v_allInvoice tmp1 WHERE COALESCE(tmp1.ordersNo, tmp1.isOrderTax) = COALESCE(g.ordersNo, tmp.ordersNo) AND tmp1.invoiceDate < tmp.invoiceDate) END, 0 ), 0 ) AS owedAmount FROM v_allInvoice AS tmp LEFT JOIN goodsorder g ON (tmp.isOrderTax != 0 AND tmp.isOrderTax = g.id) OR (tmp.ordersNo IS NOT NULL AND tmp.ordersNo = g.ordersNo)
AND tmp.invoiceDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND (tmp.tableName = 'invoiceother' AND tmp.Supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%') OR tmp.tableName = 'invoiceother' AND tmp.customer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%') OR tmp.tableName = 'invoicein' AND tmp.companyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%') OR tmp.tableName = 'invoiceout' AND tmp.companyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchCompamyName}, '%'))
AND tmp.invoiceCompanyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchInvoiceCompanyName}, '%')
ORDER BY COALESCE(g.orderDate, tmp.invoiceDate) DESC
